newsitem.title: USA: Grant sees reorgization plan file in May.
newsitem.headline: Grant sees reorgization plan file in May.

text.p: Grant Geophysical Inc said Thursday it expected to file a plan of reorganization around May 15 in its effort to emerge from bankruptcy.
The company also said U.S. bankruptcy court granted approval to one of the initial steps of re-emergence, which is an investment plan with Elliott Associates of New York.
The court approved, on April 9, Elliott's purchase of $2.5 million participation in the company's primary working capital facility with Foothill Capital Corp.
The working capital facility was extended until September 30.
Grant said it expected the reorganization plan could begin in mid-June.
